limitations: This reads already persisted public records and makes no new inference or numerical calculation.

When a saved scenario discussion is not the currently selected UI context, the browser may ask to create a matching conversation. The harness answers that request locally with the existing persisted conversation ID; it never forwards the POST.
Headless Chromium checks rendering and geometry, not provider quality, physical devices, assistive technology, or human usability.

Mission Council checks prove retrieval and rendering only. A validated status chip is a reference/contract result and is not semantic validation; the recorded Supply Chain semantic score is known to be false.

The mission bootstrap response is adjusted in-browser to place the actual saved public run from reports/v9/planning-public.json in the existing latest_run slot. This prevents a later zero-inference execution trial from changing which persisted run the UI displays.
